terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.body_html:
Welcome to Flexlore. These Terms and Conditions (“Terms”) govern your access to and use of the Flexlore platform, website, and mobile applications. By using Flexlore, you agree to comply with these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.

Acceptance of Terms

By creating a Flexlore account or using our web and mobile applications, you agree to these Terms and any related policies. If you do not agree, please stop using Flexlore.

Eligibility

Flexlore is intended for business use. You must be at least 18 years old and authorised by your organisation to create an account and manage training content on its behalf.

Account Registration

You are responsible for the accuracy of the account information you provide and for keeping your login credentials confidential. Notify us immediately if you suspect unauthorised access to your workspace.

Services Provided

Flexlore provides an AI-powered video onboarding and standard work platform. You can upload videos, turn them into step-by-step work instructions, generate quizzes, assign training, and track completion and readiness across teams and locations.

Transactions and Payments

Paid plans are billed according to the subscription or agreement in place with your organisation. Fees, billing periods, and seat counts are confirmed before activation. Unless otherwise agreed in writing, subscription fees are non-refundable for periods already used.

Acceptable Use

You agree to use Flexlore lawfully and only for legitimate training purposes. You may not upload content you have no right to share, record individuals without the permissions required in your jurisdiction, attempt to reverse engineer the platform, or use it to store unrelated sensitive personal data.

Security and Privacy

We apply technical and organisational measures to protect your workspace and training content. No platform can guarantee absolute security, so you remain responsible for managing user roles, access permissions, and credential hygiene inside your workspace.

Suspension and Termination

We may suspend or terminate access if these Terms are breached, if usage puts the platform or other customers at risk, or if fees remain unpaid. You may end your subscription in line with your agreement; you can export or request your content before closure.

Governing Law and Dispute Resolution

These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, United States, without regard to conflict of law principles. The state and federal courts located in Delaware have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising from these Terms or your use of Flexlore, and you consent to that jurisdiction and venue.

Changes to Terms and Conditions

We may update these Terms as Flexlore evolves. Material changes will be communicated through the platform or by email, and continued use after the effective date means you accept the updated Terms.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about these Terms, please contact us at support@flexlore.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body_html:
At Flexlore, we are committed to protecting your privacy and the security of your training data. This Privacy Policy explains what we collect, how we use and store it, and the choices you have when using our onboarding and standard work platform.

Information We Collect

We collect account data such as your name, work email, phone number, organisation, and role; workspace content such as videos, work instructions, quizzes, and training results; and technical data such as IP address, device and browser type, and in-product activity. We also use cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in and to understand how the product is used.

How We Use Your Information

We use your data to provide and secure the platform, deliver training and quiz functionality, generate progress and readiness reporting for your organisation, provide customer support, meet legal obligations, and send service updates. You can opt out of marketing emails at any time.

Data Sharing & Third Parties

We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with infrastructure and analytics providers that help us operate Flexlore, with AI processing services used to generate work instructions and quizzes, and with authorities where disclosure is legally required. All providers are bound by confidentiality and data protection obligations.

Data Retention

We retain workspace content for as long as your organisation maintains an active subscription, and afterwards only as required for legal, accounting, or security purposes. Account data is deleted or anonymised once retention periods expire.

Security

Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, access is restricted on a least-privilege basis, and workspace permissions are controlled by your own administrators. We monitor our systems and review our security practices regularly.

Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may request access to your personal data, correction, deletion, restriction of processing, or a copy of your data. Employees should contact their organisation first, as it acts as the controller of workspace training data.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect product or legal changes. The latest version is always available on this page, and material changes will be announced in the platform or by email.

Contact Information

For privacy questions or data requests, contact us at support@flexlore.com.
